Method of Attack: Encrypts files on network drives, network shares, USB drives, external disks, internal disks, and cloud storage apps using AES-256 encryption
Makes a copy of targeted files, encrypts the copy, overwrites original file ten times, then permanently deletes it
Deletes all shadow volume copies and overwrites RecycleBin content ten times before permanent deletion
Ransom note multiplies ransom demand by 10 if infected target is part of a domain
Impacted Systems: Cloud storage apps including Onedrive, Dropbox, Google Drive, Steam
Attack Vector: Open-source ransomware project uploaded on GitHub
